list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze (Exophase + PSNProfiles via kit, 2026-11-18)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops automatically. Everything is single-player, there is no online or DLC trophy, and one playthrough is enough. Budget roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road.

claims.t: The Platinum pops once the other 54 trophies are earned; no multiplayer or DLC trophy is needed.
All 55 trophies are offline and single-player; there are zero online trophies.
One playthrough is enough for the Platinum.
PowerPyx and GTABase put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist.
On Xbox the same objective is the 0G Mythic achievement, the counterpart to the Platinum.
Exophase tracked the Platinum at 0.01% on 21 Nov 2026, two days after launch.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it pops.

claims.t: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
It is one of the 28 hidden trophies on the PSN list.
Exophase tracked it at 100.00% among its tracked players on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 is done, as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. Finish the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before you leave this chapter.

claims.t: The trophy pops after Chapter 1, as the first mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?) begins.
It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
Chapter 1 also holds the only potentially missable trophy moment, Lucia's balcony meditation.
Exophase tracked it at 11.98% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 also unlocks partner free-roam after Coffee Break, which the partner trophies need.

claims.t: The trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City.
It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
PSN publishes the name with asterisks, T**s Ass Drug Money; some sites print it unmasked.
Chapter 2's Coffee Break mission unlocks playing as Jason and Lucia together in free roam.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 unlocks key gear: the Key Cloner, the Snap Gun and the Dye Pack Jammer.

claims.t: The trophy pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
Chapter 3 unlocks the Key Cloner (Randy), the Snap Gun (Sneakthief) and the Dye Pack Jammer (Dime on the Dollar).
Exophase tracked it at 0.03% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... unlocks the bank vault robberies.

claims.t: The trophy pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... unlocks large bank vault robberies.
Some sites print the name as Top of the World, Ma; PSN's list capitalises Of and Ma.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final mission and it pops; free roam continues afterwards, and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats. Sources disagree on whether the final mission sits in Chapter 4 or Chapter 5.

claims.t: The official description is 'Complete the final mission.'
It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
Free roam continues after the story, and the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats.
PowerPyx ties the final mission to Chapter 4's Starting From Zero; other sites word it as completing Chapter 5.
It is one of only two Gold trophies, worth 50G on Xbox.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

claims.t: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
It is one of the 28 hidden trophies.
Exophase tracked it at 4.26% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

claims.t: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
It is one of the 28 hidden trophies.
Exophase tracked it at 0.03% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

claims.t: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
It is one of the 28 hidden trophies.
Exophase tracked it at 0.02% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

claims.t: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
It is one of the 28 hidden trophies.
Exophase tracked it at 0.02% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport.

claims.t: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
VCIA is Vice City International Airport, also the site of Catch Me If You Can.
Exophase tracked it at 0.02% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

claims.t: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission.
The trophy is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
The story is divided into 5 chapters, taking around 60-80 hours.
Exophase tracked it at 0.02% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest grind, around 100 hours after the story. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done; progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.

claims.t: The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Progress made during the story already counts toward the checklist.
Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything can be done after the story in free roam.
PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion, with most side quests not required.
Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need full completion.
The checklist needs any 100 optional missions, and there are far more than 100 in the game.
It needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicle scans and 100 of 255 animal studies.
It needs 70 of 80 Challenges, so the hardest 10 can be skipped.
It needs 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts, 30 of 40 races won and 8 of 8 bank vaults.
Every guide ranks A Long Road the hardest trophy in the set.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest kind. The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

claims.t: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix of the four kinds.
The four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack up stunts.
The optional challenge attached to each stunt is not required for the trophy.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Stunts stay marked on the map after completion and each has a unique name.
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, 50 more than the trophy.
A stunt counts as completed by performing it once.
Exophase tracked the Silver at 0.01% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, winning a race, and a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see what is left. Most pop naturally while working on other trophies.

claims.t: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types.
The nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win and a stunt.
Progress > Activities shows how many of each type you have done.
Activities are marked with blue icons on the map when you unfog areas.
Most types are introduced automatically by the main story.
Working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist covers all nine on its own.
Basketball counts by scoring a basket at a hoop.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Push Square names two range locations, Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. GamesFuze names this one of the two hardest trophies.

claims.t: All 42 Shooting Range challenges need a gold medal.
The 42 challenges sit across 12 shooting ranges.
Push Square names two range locations: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero.
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some are locked until other conditions are met.
Find ranges on the map under Activities > Shooting Ranges.
Ranges raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
GamesFuze ranks The Shootist with A Long Road as the hardest trophies.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there. Some locations charge an entry fee.

claims.t: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
One win per location is enough for the trophy.
There are 42 drone races in total across the 14 locations.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races completed.
Some drone race locations require an entry fee.
View discovered locations on the map under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from, and winning the same race again does not count. Most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating can be improved with Mod Shop upgrades. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races won.

claims.t: 20 different races must be won; repeats of the same race do not count.
There are 40 unique race locations to choose from.
Track races under Activities > Racing on the map.
Most race locations let you hire a car instead of using your own.
Your car's Rating can be improved with upgrades from Mod Shops.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 races won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

missable.window: Chapter 1 · opens after Feng Shui (meet Cal)
missable.shuts: No fixed shut — start his questline as soon as it appears
missable.protect: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, watch for Cal's text and the purple fishing icon. Follow his questline and beat him; you need a boat with a fishing rod.

trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline; one challenge asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. You need a boat with a fishing rod, and plenty can be hijacked nearby.

claims.t: Cal's questline starts after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet him.
Cal texts you and marks a fishing location with a purple map icon.
One challenge asks for a Parrotfish over 2kg.
You need a boat with a fishing rod; boats in the area can be hijacked.
Beating Cal in his fishing challenge unlocks the trophy.
Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
Exophase tracked it at 13.30% on 21 Nov 2026, one of the most-earned trophies.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You only need to reach the end, not beat every challenge.

claims.t: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game.
The four are Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three play on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1.
Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world.
To complete a game you must finish all its levels at least once; challenges are not required.
Home TV play is briefly unavailable during some story sections but works again after the story.
Playing a video game is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

missable.shuts: No fixed shut — quests stay available after the story
missable.protect: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Do all five quests in order.

trophies.guide: Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia and starts in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. Complete all five quests in order; the last, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. All quests stay available after the story.

claims.t: Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia and starts in Chapter 3.
Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville.
There are 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The final quest, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy.
All Andy quests stay available after the story.
Andy's quests do not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
Exophase tracked it at 0.01% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

missable.shuts: End of Chapter 1 — Kenton goes quiet, returns in Chapter 2-3
missable.protect: Start Kenton in Chapter 1 (green KR icon, Key Lento). If he vanishes after Chapter 1, don't panic: he texts Jason again in Chapter 2-3, or call Brian as Jason to speed it up.

trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; he calls, then is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. Clear 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple treasure chest markers and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2-3, so the trophy is not missable.

claims.t: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams.
He is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
The questline asks you to clear 7 shipwrecks and bring back the treasure.
Treasure is found at purple chest markers; a metal detector digs it from the ocean floor.
Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2-3.
Calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 can speed up Kenton's return text.
Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
The final Kenton mission is named Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five jobs; the last, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy. All quests stay available after the story.

claims.t: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
It is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
There are 5 Billy quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The final quest, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy.
All Billy quests stay available after the story.
Billy's quests do not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
Exophase tracked it at 0.02% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

missable.shuts: Varies — some strands expire if left too long
missable.protect: Start stranger strands as soon as they appear. Only certain questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands. Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Many questlines do not count, including Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie. Stranger missions are not needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story. TechWiser warns some chains have story-linked windows, so start them early.

claims.t: Only certain questlines count toward the 8 strands.
Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the guides.
Check your count on the trophy's progress tracker in the trophy list.
Stranger missions are not needed for the 100% checklist.
All stranger strands stay available after the story in free roam.
TechWiser, via EGamers, warns the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have story-linked windows.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

missable.window: Chapter 3 · opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
missable.shuts: No fixed shut — deliverable after the story
missable.protect: During the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver the first car. Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check the wish list, then deliver them in good condition for more pay.

trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver a Zorrusso. He then wants 16 sports cars. Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some in fixed locations, and the cars are often found in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.

claims.t: Randy's Wish List starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
That mission unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars.
Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered in total.
Track the list under Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if they are on the list.
Delivering a car in good condition pays more.
Wish list cars are often found in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Randy is marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

missable.shuts: No fixed shut — labs stay available after the story
missable.protect: Play as Jason after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple (Take Out Kitty Litter) until Tyrone gives you his second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy.

claims.t: Tyrone's questline starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
It is only available as Jason, not as Lucia.
Synthetic Labs appear as purple map markers in Vice City.
Destroying labs is part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
After enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This, which awards the trophy.
Push Square links the questline to Kitty Litter Lab locations.
All of Tyrone's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

missable.window: Chapter 1 · opens after Down to Earth
missable.shuts: End of Chapter 1 — the balcony meditation is gone for good
missable.protect: After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. When she says she will meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Keep a manual save at the start and end of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations. The first meditation is the only potentially missable trophy moment in the game: during Chapter 1 at Jason's house, after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony. Follow her and accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2.

claims.t: There are 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations.
Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2.
The first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is the only potentially missable trophy moment.
After Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen in the morning, then walks to the balcony.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept to learn to meditate.
The balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot.
It is unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy.
The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 meditations.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

missable.shuts: No fixed shut — available after the story
missable.protect: Play as Jason after Coffee Break and watch for Bret Vogel's text, which marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His first quest gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle.

trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed; completing his 15 Target Decks is required for 100% anyway.

claims.t: Bret's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
It is exclusive to Jason; Lucia cannot receive Bret's text.
His first quest, Veteran Hunted, is marked in Lummox County.
Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons and requests specific animals.
His first quest gives the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69.
Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed.
There are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so this pops on the way to 100%. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress. Track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

claims.t: There are 18 Collectible Card sets in the game.
Any 3 complete sets unlock the trophy.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets.
Cards sold at Pawn Shops still count toward progress.
Track cards under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Push Square and PowerPyx both publish card location indexes.
Exophase tracked the Silver at 0.01% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at any 100 locations. Hold Up then R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags; there are more than 100 in total, so any mix counts. The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK scans. Track them under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

claims.t: WAiNK scans are done by holding Up then R1 on objects in the environment.
Any 100 scans count; there are more than 100 WAiNK locations in total.
Push Square counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
WAiNK is an app on Jason or Lucia's phone, opened by holding Up.
The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK scans.
Track scans under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
WAiNK also scans vehicles for Whip It Good and Randy's Wish List.
Exophase tracked the Silver at 0.01% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops automatically on the way. View them under Progress > Challenges; a checkmark in the bottom right shows completion. Leave this for late and pick the easiest ones left.

claims.t: There are 80 Challenges in the game, in eight groups of ten.
Any 50 completed Challenges unlock the trophy.
The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so the trophy pops on the way.
View Challenges under Progress > Challenges.
A checkmark in the bottom right corner shows a completed challenge.
Many challenges complete naturally while working on other trophies.
PowerPyx advises leaving this late and picking the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

missable.shuts: No fixed shut — doable any time after partner free-roam unlocks
missable.protect: You need partner free-roam, unlocked after Coffee Break. Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), build 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easiest escape.

trophies.guide: Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together. Call your partner, build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight. It also pops naturally during bank vault robberies, which instantly give 4 stars.

claims.t: Partner free-roam unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
The trophy unlocks after leaving the red heat wanted zone.
The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
A fast sports motorcycle helps cut through traffic to escape.
Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
It often pops on its own while robbing the 8 bank vaults for 100%.
Exophase tracked it at 0.31% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well; they open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Rob a couple of items in each store, ideally break the safe with sticky bombs, and keep the flashing wanted level the whole time. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth.

claims.t: Partner free-roam is required, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
You must keep the flashing wanted level through all three robberies.
The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are a good spot.
Those stores open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Rob a couple of items per store and ideally break the safe with sticky bombs.
The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
If it does not pop, rob a fourth shop and keep going.
Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting inside one or scanning it with WAiNK both count, and scanning is enough — you never need to drive them. Stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base-model scans, so this pops naturally.

claims.t: Getting inside a vehicle or scanning it with WAiNK both count as discovering it.
Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive the vehicles.
GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch, including cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes.
Standing at a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the fastest method.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned.
Track discovered vehicles under Progress > Vehicles.
Exophase tracked it at 1.70% on 21 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). Buff Focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Line up gang members at an illegal operation — PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

claims.t: Combat Focus activates with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm.
It slows time, highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff Focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline to extend it.
An assault rifle like the Duke 556 is recommended for accuracy and full-auto fire.
PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians; use gang members.
Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
Body armor from Ammu-Nation helps you step out of cover to get close.
It often pops naturally once you reach Focus level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal boarding bridge at VCIA — planes parked on the airfield do not work. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away from the airport.

claims.t: The plane must be docked to a passenger boarding bridge; airfield planes do not work.
The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4 at VCIA.
